notes.title: Update 1.1 - Steam Integration and Code Editor improvements
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Patch Notes – Update v1.1[/h1]
Thanks to the incredible feedback from our community, we’ve rolled out a new patch to squash bugs, enhance the gameplay experience, and introduce some much-requested improvements.

[h2]🔐 New Features[/h2]
[h3]Steam Login Integration[/h3]
You can now log in using your Steam account for a smoother and more secure experience.

[h3]🧠 Code Editor Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Instruction and output panels are now expandable.
[*] Added Ctrl + C support to copy code from the editor.
[*] You can now paste code into editable (blue) cells using Ctrl + V.
[*] Undo/Redo functionality added via buttons or Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y.
[*] Tab autocomplete is now supported for smoother coding.
[*] Mouse support added to select and apply code suggestions.
[/list]


[h2]🎮 Gameplay & Mission Updates[/h2]
[h3]Mission 2 Fixes[/h3]
All cameras are now hackable as intended—no more mission blockers.

[h3]Reduced Cutscene Skip Time[/h3]
You can now skip cutscenes faster, making repeat playthroughs much smoother.

[h3]🖱️ UI & Controls[/h3]
Main Menu UI Tweaks
Small adjustments to make navigation more intuitive.

[h3]Camera Movement Fixes[/h3]
Fixed an issue on certain hardware where switching between cameras caused erratic or ultra-fast movement.

[h3]Mouse Cursor Bug Fix[/h3]
Resolved the issue where the cursor would stick to the center of the screen under specific conditions.

[h3]Audio Transition Fixes[/h3]
Eliminated sudden volume spikes when switching scenes.

[h2]📦 Performance & Backend[/h2]
[h3]Optimized Course Data Fetching[/h3]
Backend changes to reduce loading delays and improve responsiveness.

[h3]Code Optimization[/h3]
Reduced FPS drops during autosaves and at the end of Mission 1.

Thank you for playing and supporting us! Keep the feedback coming and stay tuned for more exciting updates ahead.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 — First Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Thank you for jumping into our Early Access launch. We’ve been closely listening to your feedback and reports, and this first patch brings key fixes and polish across core game play, UI, and performance.[/p][p]
🔧 [b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed input lag and stutter issues on high-end PCs[/b]
Mouse movement and animation timing now behave smoothly across a wider range of hardware.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gun play improvements[/b]
Adjusted firing responsiveness and bullet behaviour to make shooting feel tighter and more satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved player movement[/b]
Movement has been smoothed out to feel more responsive and fluid during exploration and combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Code editor fix[/b]
Fixed an issue where pressing Shift + Enter in the in-game code editor caused input problems.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor UI tweaks[/b]
Cleaned up some inconsistent visuals and improved UI transitions for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Splash screen polish[/b]
Enhanced visuals and loading behaviour during the initial game launch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better camera switching[/b]
Camera transitions between modes while hacking cameras are now more seamless and visually consistent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio improvements[/b]
Adjusted volume levels, spatial audio positioning, and reduced overlapping sounds in certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single-instance enforcement[/b]
Prevented multiple instances of the game from running simultaneously to avoid accidental overlaps or crashes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save System Overhaul[/b][/p][p]Reworked the save system to avoid false Trojan detections from some antivirus software (e.g., Kaspersky). The new system reduces file write frequency, preventing false positives while improving save performance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This is just the beginning — we’re working hard on bigger content and features for future updates.
Keep sharing your thoughts and bug reports on the community hub or our Discord![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/4jBEyFsY" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey!
–[i] Team CodingKraft[/i][/p]
